searchText: I see that Snap/Fast sync is not available post-merge, what are the plans on improving the sync speed? Full sync consumes a lot of time. Snap sync is available post-merge at least on geth with a CL that allows for optimistic sync to the head I'm syncing up on Kiln using Geth's snap, and I see that it fell back to full sync when the TTD was reached Ah, I see that there is some kind of fast sync going on now Sorry I was wrong, the warn log that sounded like "discarding legacy sync mode" confused me. Post-merge consensus is much more complex 😅 what is the default if no parameter is given? thx. Snap
